decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [24.143 001-C, 24.143 010-B, 24.143 012-A, Cover Letter dated on 29 August 2025, Letter from Chiswick Rugby Football Club dated on 19th August 2025, Transport Statement, Metropolitan Open Land Assessment, Light Pollution Assessment, Fire Safety Strategy, Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Biodiversity Net Gain Assessment, Preliminary Ecological Appraisal. Received: 05/09/2025 
The Statutory Biodiversity Metric. Received: 01/10/2025
Community Benefits Statement and Noise Assessment Methodology. Received: 19/11/2025 
Noise Impact Assessment. Received: 26/01/2026].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The approved containers shall be ancillary to the approved development and shall not be used independently.
Reason: To ensure the development would be appropriate in Metropolitan Open Land

Condition : 4 - No development shall be occupied until a Community Use Agreement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to include benefits to residents and community organisations of the London Borough of Hounslow, including priority access, subsidised hours, schools, youth and community program, local recruitment and training. 
Reason: In order to promote the wellbeing of neighbouring residents.

Condition : 6 - Prior to the first use or occupation of the development, updated details of parking have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: In order to ensure that sufficient parking spaces are made available.

Condition : 7 - Prior to the first use or occupation of the development, full details (including manufacturers' specifications) of cycle parking facilities that accord with the West London Cycle Parking Guidance for the visitors to the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use before the development is first occupied or brought into use, The approved facilities shall be thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.

Condition : 8 - Noise from uses and activities associated with the playing of padel shall not exceed the calculated noise levels stated in Section 5.11 and detailed in Table 4 of the approved Noise Impact Assessment (report reference RP01-25136-R0) dated 5th December 2025.
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the nearest noise sensitive receptors are not adversely affected by noise.

Condition : 9 - The lighting details, including mitigations, shown on the approved plans and Light Pollution Assessment (reference: 7038) dated on 22 August 2025 shall be carried out as approved.
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the are not adversely affected.

Condition : 10 - The trees that are specified on the drawings hereby approved to be retained shall be protected before commencement of any works on site and throughout the course of the development by methods that conform to the best practice guidance contained in British Standard BS5837: 2012 or any guidance that shall have superseded it

Reason: In order to ensure a satisfactory appearance of the site and the area and to promote biodiversity.

Condition : 11 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Preliminary Ecological Appraisal. 
Reason: In the interests of biodiversity.
description: Creation of five padel tennis courts with three containers, floodlights, an entertainment area, seating area and associated services including cycle parking.
